summary: Majesty: The Northern Expansion - The Dragons are waiting for their dinner.
description: One of the 5 Best Tablet Games According to The New York Times 👉 Do you know the easiest way to kill a dragon? ✅ Stuff a sheep or a ram with as much poisonous nastiness as possible and feed it to the beast. It may not be the most heroic method, but it is effective and safe. ✅ Another option is to put a bounty on the lizard’s head and wait until an army of heroes, wizards, and town madmen drives it into the grave. You definitely have to do something about the dragon problem, because every member of this scaly tribe suffers from the same illness: a terrible allergy to humans, and especially to human settlements. And dragons all treat it the same way — with the total annihilation of anything walking on two legs. Fans of Lessaria and Crown of Greed will likely appreciate this dark yet fairy-tale-like fantasy setting. In Majesty: The Northern Expansion, dragon troubles take center stage. Of course, you will still have to defend your kingdom from all kinds of other evil creatures — just think of the massive stone golems with their seemingly endless supply of health. But as you expand your kingdom to the north, invading a land of snow and frost, you will inevitably have to puzzle over how to deal with these winged, fire-breathing monsters. Immerse yourself in the charming world of Majesty, a game that inspired many others, including the acclaimed Lessaria and Crown of Greed. Everyone who loved the original mobile game Majesty: The Fantasy Kingdom Sim will no doubt enjoy the full-fledged expansion Majesty: The Northern Expansion, where players can continue their conquests in a brand-new location — the Northern Lands. The add-on features improved graphics, dynamic weather, and social network integration. And those who enjoy Lessaria and Crown of Greed will especially appreciate the atmospheric fantasy setting, indirect hero control, and strong focus on kingdom development. Game Features • New missions and a new location — the Northern Lands • A legendary indirect-control strategy fully adapted for mobile platforms • 10 hero types with dozens of stats, as well as unique weapons and armor • New monster types • Several dozen spells • 30 building types with upgrade options • Dynamic weather • All in-game achievements can be shared on your social network pages with a single tap • A new free-play mode (Skirmish Mode) • The QualityIndex of Majesty is 7.0 http://android.qualityindex.com/games/44367/majesty-northern-expansion
